purpose: Define weekly MeritCore reporting intervals anchored to each user's registration date, with hour-level evidence distribution inside each recurring week.

topics.name: MeritCore Weekly Reporting Cadence
topics.purpose: Define weekly MeritCore reporting intervals anchored to each user's registration date, with hour-level evidence distribution inside each recurring week.

semantics.anchor_rule: Weekly reporting cadence is anchored to the user's registration date, not Project start date.
semantics.period_rule: Reporting intervals recur in one-week periods from that identity-specific anchor.
semantics.hour_rule: Sub-week work evidence may be represented at hour-atom granularity within the weekly interval.
semantics.project_rule: Project work crossing intervals is distributed to the applicable user-anchored reporting periods.
semantics.identity_rule: Different identities may therefore have different weekly interval boundaries.
semantics.nonmultiplication_rule: Distribution across reporting intervals cannot duplicate the same hour/evidence.
semantics.presentation_rule: Calendar-week views may be derived separately but do not replace canonical registration-anchored cadence.

invariants.rule: MeritCore derives human competence/trust history from explicit identity-bound Project evidence; identities, evidence, recommendations, points, Tier and broker relevance remain separate semantic dimensions.

hard_gates.condition: weekly cadence anchored to Project start
all users forced to calendar-week semantic anchor
same hour counted in multiple reporting periods
calendar presentation silently changes canonical cadence

references.purpose: Project time atoms feed user-anchored Merit reporting.
